title: combine plans and tasks bottom right. Call tasks and have plan still show above. If task doesn't have plan just have No…
summary: I've written the plan; nothing has been changed yet. The PLANS tab in the bottom-right panel goes away, so the tabs become `SANDBOX | PROCESSES | TRACE | TASKS`. The TASKS tab groups each task under the plan it works on, with the plan's header and todos shown above its tasks. Tasks with no plan go under a "No Plan" header, which only appears when such tasks exist.
